## Notes

eGenesis; First Telling launched 2003-02-15; later Pluribus Games and Desert Nomad Studios. Windows, Linux, Mac. No combat; Tellings average about 18 months and end in a wipe; seven tests per discipline leading to Oracle rank and Monuments; laws by petition with signatures then a vote, a controlled variant of Nomic; elected Demi-Pharaoh can ban up to seven characters; no official currency; gathering wood, mining, flax.
